name: Create a Linear issue
description: File a new issue in a Linear team with title, description, and labels.
when_to_use: The user wants to create, file, or open a new Linear issue or ticket.
body: Create an issue in Linear via the GraphQL API.

name: Update a Linear issue
description: Change status, assignee, priority, or labels on an existing Linear issue.
when_to_use: The user wants to close, move, assign, or edit an existing Linear issue.
body: Update fields on an existing Linear issue.

name: Open a pull request
description: Create a GitHub pull request from a branch with a clear title and body.
when_to_use: The user wants to open, create, or submit a pull request on GitHub.
body: Use the gh CLI or the REST API to open a pull request.

name: Review a pull request
description: Read a GitHub pull request diff and leave review comments.
when_to_use: The user wants to review, comment on, or approve a pull request.
body: Fetch the pull request diff and leave a review.

name: Analyze a slow query
description: Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to find why a PostgreSQL query is slow.
when_to_use: The user asks why a database query is slow or how to speed it up.
body: Run EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) and read the plan.

name: Write a database migration
description: Add or change a PostgreSQL schema with a reversible migration.
when_to_use: The user wants to add a table, column, or index as a migration.
body: Write an up and down migration.

name: Shrink a Docker image
description: Rewrite a Dockerfile with multi-stage builds and a slim base to cut image size.
when_to_use: The user wants a smaller or faster Docker image.
body: Use multi-stage builds and distroless bases.

name: Deploy to Kubernetes
description: Apply a deployment, service, and config to a Kubernetes cluster.
when_to_use: The user wants to deploy or roll out a service to Kubernetes.
body: Apply manifests and watch the rollout.

name: Triage an incident
description: Stabilize a production incident, then find the cause and write it up.
when_to_use: Production is broken and the user needs to triage an outage.
body: Stabilize, then diagnose, then write up.

name: Write a commit message
description: Draft a Conventional Commits message from a staged change.
when_to_use: The user asks for a commit message or is ready to commit.

name: Design API error handling
description: Choose HTTP status codes and a stable error body shape.
when_to_use: Designing or reviewing an HTTP API's error responses.
body: One error shape, correct status codes.

name: Fix React re-renders
description: Find and fix unnecessary re-renders in a React component tree.
when_to_use: A React UI is slow or re-renders too often.
body: Memoize, colocate state, and split context.
